section_path: CAPA — Phase I CNS Safety and Tolerability Deviation Trend
Root Cause and Action
chunks.text:
Corrective and preventive action arising from repeated deviations on study QP-2402-CNS.

Arises from deviation DEV-2402-0489 on study QP-2402-CNS.

Root cause: procedure SOP-CL-211 did not state the required action clearly enough at the
point of use, leading to source data not reconciled to the case report form within the
interval.

Corrective action: revise SOP-CL-211 and retrain affected personnel. Preventive action: add
a system check in the electronic data capture system.

Effectiveness is verified within 24 hours of awareness after implementation.
chunks.paragraph_excerpt: Corrective and preventive action arising from repeated deviations on study QP-2402-CNS.
